segments.sn10.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn10.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako sukkāya bhikkhuniyā bhojanaṃ adāsi.
segments.sn10.10:1.3: Atha kho sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn10.10:2.1: “Puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ, sappañño vatāyaṃ upāsako;
segments.sn10.10:2.3: Yo sukkāya adāsi bhojanaṃ, sabbaganthehi vippamuttiyā”ti [vippamuttāyāti (syā. kaṃ.)].

lines: Dasame puññaṃ vata pasavi bahunti bahuṃ vata puññaṃ pasavatīti.
